label: PI / EMI Authorisation Roadmap
description: Builds the authorisation roadmap for a Payment Institution or E-Money Institution under PSD2 (EU) 2015/2366 and EMD2 2009/110/EC — from gap assessment to a submission-ready application dossier. Covers the programme of operations, business plan, initial capital and own-funds methods A/B/C, safeguarding, governance and outsourcing, security/SCA and operational-and-security risk (DORA interface), PII for AISP/PISP, the NCA timeline, passporting, and wind-down planning.

claudeKnowledge.description: PSD2 Directive (EU) 2015/2366 and its Annex I services; EMD2 Directive 2009/110/EC; EBA Guidelines on authorisation and registration under PSD2 (EBA/GL/2017/09); EBA RTS on SCA and common secure communication (Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/389); EBA Guidelines on ICT and security risk management (EBA/GL/2019/04) and their migration to DORA (Regulation (EU) 2022/2554); EBA Guidelines on the PII minimum monetary amount for PISP/AISP (EBA/GL/2017/08); national NCA application packs (Finansinspektionen, Finanssivalvonta, BaFin, CBI, DNB, CSSF); the PSD3 Directive and PSR proposals (COM(2023) 366 and COM(2023) 367) as forthcoming, not yet in force.

guidedInputs.label: Authorisation sought
guidedInputs.description: Which licence are you applying for? This drives the capital, safeguarding and PII expectations.

options.label: Account Information Service Provider only (registration, PSD2 Art. 33)
Small / limited-network Payment Institution (national exemption, Art. 32)
Small E-Money Institution (national waiver, EMD2 Art. 9)

guidedInputs.label: Home Member State / NCA
guidedInputs.description: Where will you seek authorisation? Determines the competent authority, the application pack and language.

guidedInputs.label: Annex I payment services in scope
guidedInputs.description: Which PSD2 Annex I services will the institution provide? Each adds specific dossier content.

options.label: Cash placement / withdrawal on a payment account (Annex I(1)–(2))
Execution of payment transactions — credit transfers, direct debits, card (Annex I(3))
Execution where funds covered by a credit line (Annex I(4))
Issuing and/or acquiring of payment instruments (Annex I(5))

guidedInputs.label: Preferred own-funds method (PI)
guidedInputs.description: For a Payment Institution, which ongoing own-funds method do you intend to use (PSD2 Art. 9)? EMIs use the EMD2 Art. 5 average-outstanding-e-money method.

options.label: Not yet decided — recommend a method
Method A — 10% of preceding-year fixed overheads
Method B — scaled % of payment volume (k-factor applied)
Method C — % of income (relevant indicator x multiplication factor)
EMI — 2% of average outstanding e-money (EMD2 Art. 5)

guidedInputs.label: Where are you in the journey?
guidedInputs.description: Sets whether this is a gap assessment, a dossier-build, or a pre-submission review.

options.label: Scoping — deciding licence type and perimeter
Gap assessment — what is missing for an application
Pre-submission review of a near-complete pack

guidedInputs.label: Known concerns, constraints or open questions
guidedInputs.description: Describe your business model, funding flows, safeguarding approach, outsourcing, and any known weak spots or NCA pre-application feedback.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Safeguarding via segregated client account at a partner bank but no fallback insurance arrangement; cloud-hosted core with a single critical outsourcer (DORA register not built); two proposed board members lack regulated-firm experience; uncertain which own-funds method gives the lowest ongoing capital; want to passport into DE/FR within 12 months.

exampleInput: We are a Stockholm-based fintech (18 FTE, pre-revenue) preparing a full Payment Institution application to Finansinspektionen. We will offer money remittance (Annex I(6)) and payment-initiation services (PISP, Annex I(7)) to SMEs across the Nordics, with passporting into Germany and the Netherlands planned within 12 months. We have a draft business plan and a three-year P&L, but our programme of operations is thin on transaction flows, and we have not modelled which own-funds method (A/B/C) minimises ongoing capital. Safeguarding will be a segregated client-money account at a Swedish partner bank; we have no insurance/guarantee fallback yet. Core processing is on AWS via one critical outsourcer — we have not built a DORA outsourcing register or an ICT third-party risk assessment, and our SCA design (RTS (EU) 2018/389) is still conceptual. Two of our four proposed board members have never worked in a regulated firm. Produce an authorisation roadmap: tell us exactly what the FI dossier must contain, where our biggest gaps are, the realistic timeline including the NCA clock, the PII we need as a PISP, and a wind-down plan outline. Bridge from our PSD3 gap analysis to a submission-ready pack.

exampleValues.known_concerns: Programme of operations thin on transaction flows; own-funds method A/B/C not modelled. Safeguarding via segregated client account at a Swedish partner bank, no insurance/guarantee fallback. Single critical cloud outsourcer (AWS) — no DORA outsourcing register or ICT third-party risk assessment. SCA design still conceptual. Two of four proposed board members have no regulated-firm experience. Passporting into DE and NL planned within 12 months.
